welcome.title: Before you start
welcome.parentTitle: Notosaurus is a tool for parents.
welcome.parent: You must be an adult to use it: you prepare the cards, your child revises them in Anki.
welcome.ai: to read the photos and make the cards. Photos, instructions and dictations go through the Notosaurus service while the cards are made, without being stored there, and are processed in the European Union.
welcome.onPhone: Your lessons stay on your phone.
welcome.google: Google may keep what it is sent for up to 90 days to detect abuse, without using it to train its AI.
welcome.guardTitle: The AI has safeguards suited to pupils,
welcome.guard: but it can make mistakes: check the cards before giving them to your child.
welcome.nameTitle: A notebook page often shows the child's name:
welcome.name: hide it with 🖍️ before sending.
welcome.trialTitle: The first lesson starts a free trial,
welcome.trial: no card, once per phone (Google checks that it is a real phone, the app knows this one by a fingerprint).
welcome.agree: I am a parent (an adult) and I accept the privacy policy.

create.title: 🔐 Create the password
create.hint: This page holds the API keys. Choose a password to protect it: other users of the app won't be able to open it.

provider.title: AI service

gemini.name: Gemini (Google)
gemini.description: Fast and cheap (≈ 1 US¢ per lesson). A free key works too, with an older model and low limits.

anthropic.name: Claude (Anthropic)
anthropic.description: Very good reading, handwriting included. Paid, a few cents per lesson.

openai.name: GPT (OpenAI)
openai.description: GPT models, with an OpenAI key. Paid, a few cents per lesson.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: One key for Gemini, Claude, GPT, Mistral… and always their latest version. The exact cost of each lesson.

compatible.name: Other OpenAI-compatible service
compatible.description: A model at home (Ollama, LM Studio…) or another service (Mistral…), at its address.

fake.name: Demo
fake.description: Canned cards, for tests and development.
fake.warning: Demo mode: the cards don't come from your photos, they are always the same. Choose another provider to use Notosaurus.

provider.fallbacksHint: Tried in order when the main model is overloaded or has no quota (a free key doesn't get the latest model). Comma-separated.

access.title: Access
access.compatibleKey: Service API key (often not needed for a local model)
access.replaceHint: To replace it, paste the new key.
access.willBeCleared: Will be deleted when you save.
access.ollamaHint: OpenAI-compatible service: its address usually ends with /v1 (local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1).
access.testOk: ✓ {model} reads images and answers in the right format ({seconds} s).
access.testOkQuota: ✓ Your key works with {model} ({seconds} s): {quota} isn't included in its plan (free?). Turn on billing for the key in Google AI Studio to get it (≈ 1 US¢ per lesson).
access.testNoVision: ⚠ {model} answers, but doesn't seem to see the image (it said “{answer}” for a red square). Pick a model that accepts images.
access.testNoJson: ⚠ {model} doesn't answer in the requested JSON format: pick another model.
access.testRefused: ⚠ {model} doesn't accept images (“{refused}”). Pick a vision model.

voice.rate: Slow down foreign languages and dictations

anki.title: 📥 Send straight to Anki
anki.embedded: ✓ Notosaurus runs inside the Anki add-on: “Add to Anki” writes straight into the open profile, no AnkiConnect needed.
anki.howTo: To add cards without an .apkg file: in Anki on the computer, Tools → Add-ons → Get Add-ons, code 2055492159 (AnkiConnect), then restart Anki. Anki must be open while sending. Or install the Notosaurus add-on, which runs Notosaurus inside Anki.
anki.addressHint: Anki on the same computer as Notosaurus: http://localhost:8765.
anki.syncHint: (to get the cards on the phone)
anki.testNoProfile: Anki answers, but no profile is open: open one in Anki.
anki.syncOff: “{profile}” isn't logged in to AnkiWeb: no sync after sending. To sync, log in in Anki (Sync button).

transfer.title: 💾 Back up or move my lessons
transfer.hint: One file with every lesson (photos, cards, pictures, sounds), the children, the tests and your prompts: to keep them, or to open them on another computer or in the Android app. Their cards already in Anki are found there again, never added twice.

transfer.private: The file holds the lessons' photos and the children's names: keep it to yourself. It holds no key and no password.

addon.stoppedAtStart: The Notosaurus server stopped while starting.
addon.phoneSteps:
1. Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
2. Scan this QR code with the phone's camera.
3. In the browser: menu → “Add to Home screen”, to use it like an app.

Settings (AI keys…) open here, on the computer: Tools → Notosaurus → Settings.
addon.localOnly: ⚠ The server only listens on this computer (“host” set to 127.0.0.1): set “0.0.0.0” in the add-on config to reach it from the phone.
addon.notRunningYet: Notosaurus is starting: try again in a few seconds.
addon.installConfirm:
Before it can start, Notosaurus must install its components:

• uv (from GitHub), Python 3.13 and its Python libraries (from PyPI): about 300 MB on disk;
• only in Anki's folder (Anki2/notosaurus-runtime): nothing changes on the rest of the computer, and removing the add-on removes them.

This takes a minute or two, the first time and after some updates. Install now?
addon.installDeclined: Notosaurus isn't started. To install it later: Tools → Notosaurus → Open Notosaurus.
addon.setupConfirm:
Notosaurus is installed. Set it up now? Two steps, a few minutes: an AI to read the lessons (with its key), then your phone.

The assistant opens in your browser.
